verdict.rationale: Kick has native invoicing (view synced invoices from Stripe/Mercury/BILL, create/send invoices) and its Plus plan explicitly lists 'AR & AP' as a feature, showing AR tracking exists at some level. However, unlike Bill Pay/AP where docs explicitly describe 'AP aging' and 'vendor balances' (kick-docs-22), no equivalent AR aging report or per-customer balance view is documented for receivables. Missing for 10: explicit AR aging report documentation, per-customer balance breakdowns, and any screenshots/hands-on confirmation of AR reporting depth.
